Name: Spill The Tea (Farmer Drinking Sprites)
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Small edit to change how the farmer takes their tea
Description:
Small edit to change how the farmer takes their tea
Should be compatible with other farmer mods since this mod only changes a small part of the spritesheet, not the whole thing

_Quick start_

*   Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)  )

*   it's ready to play!
Note: There are three colour variations, and it's possible to have the cup changes without the face changes if you leave the config option blank. Choose which design you want by typing it into the config.json (you will need to launch your game once for the config.json to be created), or in-game using [GMCM](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098). The options are CoffeeCup, Teacup, and WhiteTeacup.

_Compatibility_

*   Mobile compatible

*   Tested with GH Peach Farmer body, Indie's Female overhaul, Curvy Farmer, and Elegant Farmer.
